Output the N by N result table: entry (i,j) is o if i beat j, x if i lost to j, and - if they have not played each other (including i=j). Constraints: 1<=N<=100 and 0<=M<=N(N-1)/2.

Each organization submits its own one report together with all reports received from descendants to its parent; organization 0 submits them to the president. label: ABC264B
cn: 给定15×15同心方框图中的坐标(R,C)。判断该格是黑色还是白色，并输出black或white。
en: For a fixed 15 by 15 pattern of concentric square frames, given cell (R,C), determine whether it is black or white.
title: Nice Grid

label: ABC263B
cn: N个人构成一棵以1为根的上下级树；对i=2⋯N给出其直接上司Pi。求从N号人向上走到1号人需要经过多少条边。
en: N people form a rooted supervisor tree with person 1 at the root; for i=2...N, Pi is the direct supervisor of i. Find the number of edges from person N up to person 1.
title: Ancestor

label: ABC229A
cn: 给定2×2网格，恰有两个#。判断这两个#是否共享边；若共享输出Yes，否则输出No。
en: Given a 2 by 2 grid containing exactly two # cells, determine whether the two # cells share an edge.
title: First Grid

label: ABC228B
cn: N个人每人只知道一个人的秘密，Ai表示第i人会把秘密传给Ai。秘密从X开始传播，求最终知道秘密的人数。
en: Each of N people forwards a secret to exactly one person Ai. Starting from person X, repeatedly forward the secret and count how many distinct people eventually learn it.
title: Takahashi's Secret

label: ABC218A
cn: 给定长度N的字符串S与位置K。若S的第K个字符是o输出Yes，否则输出No。
en: Given a length-N string S and position K, print Yes if the K-th character is o, otherwise No.
title: Weather Forecast

label: ABC217B
cn: 四种比赛名为ABC、ARC、AGC、AHC。给定其中三个，输出缺少的那个。
en: The four contest names are ABC, ARC, AGC, and AHC. Given three of them, output the missing one.
title: AtCoder Quiz

label: ABC216A
cn: 给定一位小数X.Y。若Y∈{0,1,2}输出X-；若Y∈{3,4,5,6}输出X；若Y∈{7,8,9}输出X+。
en: Given a one-decimal number X.Y, print Xif Y is 0,1,2; X if Y is 3,4,5,6; and X+ if Y is 7,8,9.
title: Signed Difficulty

label: ABC213B
cn: 给定N个互不相同的分数。输出第二高分对应的1-based编号。
en: Given N pairwise distinct scores, output the 1-based index of the second-highest score.
title: Booby Prize

label: ABC203A
cn: 给定三个骰子点数a、b、c（均为1～6）。若三者中存在两个相同的点数，则输出“剩下那一个骰子”的点数；若三个点数两两不同，则输出0。三者全相同时，剩下的点数也与它们相同，因此输出该点数。
en: Given three die results a, b, and c, each between 1 and 6. If two of the three values are equal, print the value on the remaining die; if all three values are pairwise different, print 0. When all three are equal, the remaining value is the same value, so print it.
title: Chinchirorin

label: ABC201A
cn: 给定三个整数。判断重新排序后能否构成等差数列。
en: Given three integers, determine whether they can be reordered to form an arithmetic progression.
title: Tiny Arithmetic Sequence

label: ABC200A
cn: 给定公历年份N，输出它属于第几个世纪。
en: Given a calendar year N, output its century number.
title: Century

label: ABC185B
cn: 手机初始电量N，时间流逝时每分钟耗1；在若干咖啡店停留区间内每分钟回1，但不超过N。判断到时间T时手机是否始终未关机。
en: A phone starts with battery N, loses 1 per minute over time, and gains 1 per minute while inside given cafe intervals, capped at N. Determine whether it stays powered on until time T.
title: Smartphone Addiction

label: ABC183B
cn: 两点为(Sx,Sy)与(Gx,-Gy)。连接它们的直线与x轴相交，求交点的x坐标。
en: Two points are (Sx,Sy) and (Gx,-Gy). Find the x-coordinate where the line through them intersects the x-axis.
title: Billiards

label: ABC181B
cn: 给定N个闭区间[Ai,Bi]。求所有区间中全部整数之和，即Σ_i Σ_{x=Ai}^{Bi} x。
en: Given N closed integer intervals [Ai,Bi], compute the sum of every integer in every interval: sum_i sum_{x=Ai} ^{Bi} x.
title: Trapezoid Sum

label: ABC175A
cn: 给定长度为3、只含R与S的字符串。求连续R的最大长度。
en: Given a length-3 string containing only R and S, find the maximum number of consecutive R characters.
title: Rainy Season

label: ABC172B
cn: 给定两个等长字符串S、T。统计位置i满足S[i]≠T[i]的数量。
en: Given equal-length strings S and T, count positions i for which S[i] differs from T[i].
title: Minor Change

label: ABC157B
cn: 给定3×3宾果盘上的9个整数，再给出若干被叫到的数。判断最终是否存在一整行、一整列或一条对角线全部被叫到。
en: Given a 3 by 3 bingo board and a list of called numbers, determine whether any row, column, or main diagonal is completely marked.
title: Bingo

label: ABC141B
cn: 给定字符串S。奇数位置只允许R/U/D，偶数位置只允许L/U/D。判断整个字符串是否满足规则。
en: Given a string S, odd positions may contain only R/U/D and even positions only L/U/D. Determine whether the whole string is valid.
title: Tap Dance

label: ABC138B
cn: 有N个电阻并联，阻值为Ai。并联总阻值为1/(1/A1+⋯+1/AN)，输出该值。
en: N resistors with resistances Ai are connected in parallel. Output the equivalent resistance 1/(1/A1+...+1/AN).
title: Resistors in Parallel

label: ABC137B
cn: 给定K、X。输出所有满足|x-X|<K的整数x，按升序排列。
en: Given K and X, output all integers x satisfying |x-X|<K in increasing order.
title: One Clue

label: ABC136B
cn: 给定N。统计1⋯N中十进制位数为奇数的整数个数。
en: Given N, count integers from 1 through N whose decimal representation has an odd number of digits.
title: Uneven Numbers

label: ABC135B
cn: 给定1⋯N的一个排列。判断是否能通过至多一次交换两个位置把它变成升序排列。
en: Given a permutation of 1...N, determine whether it can be sorted into increasing order using at most one swap of two positions.
title: 0 or 1 Swap

label: ABC133B
cn: 给定N个D维整数点。统计欧氏距离为整数的点对数量。
en: Given N integer points in D dimensions, count pairs whose Euclidean distance is an integer.
title: Good Distance

label: ABC132B
cn: 给定排列p。统计2≤i≤N-1中，pi的值严格位于p[i-1]与p[i+1]之间的位置个数。
en: Given a permutation p, count indices 2<=i<=N-1 for which pi lies strictly between p[i-1] and p[i+1].
title: Ordinary Number

label: ABC130B
cn: 从位置0开始，依次前进L1,L2,⋯,LN。给定上限X，统计包括初始位置在内、坐标不超过X的到达位置数量。
en: Starting at position 0, move successively by L1,L2,...,LN. Given X, count visited positions, including the start, whose coordinate is at most X.
title: Bounding

label: ABC209C
cn: 给定非负整数数组A。要选择数组B，使0≤Bi≤Ai且所有Bi两两不同。求可行B的数量，答案对1e9+7取模。
en: Given nonnegative integers A, choose B with 0<=Bi<=Ai and all Bi pairwise distinct. Count the valid arrays B modulo 1e9+7.
title: Not Equal

label: ABC085C
cn: 有N张纸币，总金额为Y日元，只使用10000、5000、1000日元纸币。找出任意一组张数(x,y,z)满足x+y+z=N且金额为Y；不存在则输出-1 -1 -1。
en: There are N banknotes totaling Y yen, using only 10000-, 5000-, and 1000-yen notes. Find any counts (x,y,z) with x+y+z=N and the required total, or print -1 -1 -1 if impossible.
title: Otoshidama

label: ABC086C
cn: 从(0,0)在时刻0出发，每单位时间可向上下左右移动一格或原地等待。给定按时间递增的目标(t_i,x_i,y_i)，判断能否按顺序在各时刻到达各目标。
en: Starting at (0,0) at time 0, you may move one grid step or stay each unit of time. Given targets (t_i,x_i,y_i) in increasing time order, determine whether all can be visited at the specified times.
title: Traveling

label: ABC344B
cn: 连续读入整数，直到读到0为止；输入个数N不事先给出。把读到的全部整数按逆序逐行输出。
en: Read integers one per line until 0 appears; N is not given. Print all read integers in reverse order, one per line.
title: Delimiter

label: ABC343B
cn: 给定N×N的0/1邻接矩阵。对每个顶点i，按编号递增输出所有与i相邻的顶点编号。
en: Given an N by N 0/1 adjacency matrix, for each vertex i print all adjacent vertex numbers in increasing order.
title: Adjacency Matrix

label: ABC342B
cn: 给定N个人的一个排列P，表示从前到后的顺序。对Q个询问(A,B)，输出两人中排在更前面的那个编号。
en: A permutation P gives the front-to-back order of N people. For each of Q queries (A,B), output whichever person appears earlier.
title: Which is ahead?

label: ABC341B
cn: 有N种货币，初始数量为A_i。对i=1..N-1，可把每S_i单位第i种货币兑换成T_i单位第i+1种货币，并尽可能兑换；输出最终第N种货币数量。
en: There are N currencies with initial amounts A_i. For i=1..N-1, exchange as many groups of S_i units of currency i as possible into T_i units of currency i+1. Output the final amount of currency N.
title: Foreign Exchange

label: ABC340B
cn: 处理Q个查询：类型1把整数x追加到序列末尾；类型2给定k，输出当前序列倒数第k个元素。
en: Process Q queries: type 1 appends an integer x to a sequence; type 2 gives k and asks for the k-th element from the end.
title: Append

label: ABC338B
cn: 给定一个小写字符串S。输出出现次数最多的字符；若并列，输出字典序最小的那个。
en: Given a lowercase string S, output its most frequent character; break ties by lexicographically smallest character.
title: Frequency

label: ABC337B
cn: 给定只含A、B、C的字符串S。判断它能否写成若干个A、接若干个B、再接若干个C，其中每段长度都允许为0。
en: Given a string S containing only A, B, and C, determine whether it can be written as some A’s, followed by some B’s, followed by some C’s, allowing any segment to be empty.
title: Extended ABC

label: ABC336B
cn: 给定正整数N，求其二进制表示末尾连续0的个数，也即最大的k使2^k整除N。
en: Given a positive integer N, find the number of trailing zeros in its binary representation, equivalently the largest k such that 2^k divides N.
title: CTZ

label: ABC335B
cn: 给定非负整数N，按字典序输出所有非负整数三元组(x,y,z)，满足x+y+z≤N。
en: Given a nonnegative integer N, print in lexicographic order all triples of nonnegative integers (x,y,z) satisfying x+y+z<=N.
title: Tetrahedral Number

label: ABC334B
cn: 所有圣诞树位于数轴上的A+kM（k为整数）处。给定闭区间[L,R]，求其中包含多少棵树。
en: Christmas trees are located at all positions A+kM for integer k. Given a closed interval [L,R], count how many tree positions lie inside it.
title: Christmas Trees

label: ABC303C
cn: 人物从(0,0)出发，按字符串S的R/L/U/D移动；每步体力减1。若体力变负则失败；若到达有道具的点且当前体力<K，则消耗该道具并把体力恢复到K。判断能否完成全部N步。
en: Start at (0,0) and follow an R/L/U/D string. Health decreases by 1 per move; negative health means failure. If you arrive at an item and health<K, consume it to restore health to K. Determine whether all N moves can be completed.
title: Dash

label: ABC302C
cn: 给定N个长度M的字符串。判断能否重新排列它们，使相邻两个字符串恰好只有一个位置字符不同。
en: Given N strings of length M, determine whether they can be reordered so that every adjacent pair differs in exactly one character position.
title: Almost Equal

label: ABC301C
cn: 给定等长字符串S、T，由小写字母与@组成。每个@可分别替换为atcoder中的任意一个字母。判断能否使两字符串完全相同。
en: Given equal-length strings S and T of lowercase letters and @. Each @ may independently be replaced by any letter appearing in atcoder. Determine whether the strings can be made identical.
title: AtCoder Cards

label: ABC300C
cn: 给定H×W的#/.网格。一个叉号由中心及四条对角线方向上等长连续的#构成。对每个可能尺寸，统计网格中该尺寸叉号的数量。
en: Given an H by W grid of # and., a cross consists of a center and equal-length diagonal arms of # cells. For each possible size, count how many crosses of that size occur.
title: Cross

label: ABC289C
cn: 全集为{1,⋯,N}，给定M个子集。统计从这M个子集中选若干个，使它们的并集等于全集的选法数量。
en: The universe is {1,...,N}, and M subsets are given. Count ways to choose some of the M subsets so that their union equals the whole universe.
title: Coverage

label: ABC287C
cn: 给定一个N点M边的简单无向图。判断它是否恰好是一条包含所有顶点的简单路径图。
en: Given a simple undirected graph with N vertices and M edges, determine whether it is exactly one simple path containing all vertices.
title: Path Graph?

label: ABC286C
cn: 给定长度N的字符串S，以及两种操作成本：把首字符移到末尾的成本A；修改任意一个字符的成本B。求通过操作使字符串成为回文串的最小成本。
en: Given a length-N string S, rotating the first character to the end costs A and changing any one character costs B. Find the minimum cost to make the string a palindrome.
title: Rotate and Palindrome

label: ABC282C
cn: 给定含逗号和双引号的字符串。双引号成对出现；仅把不处于双引号包围区域内的逗号替换为句点，输出结果。
en: Given a string containing commas and double quotes, with quotes appearing in pairs, replace only commas outside quoted regions with periods and print the result.
title: String Delimiter

label: ABC281C
cn: 有N首歌，第i首时长Ai，循环播放歌单。给定时间T，求T时刻正在播放第几首歌，以及已播放该首歌多少时间。
en: A playlist of N songs with durations Ai repeats forever. Given time T, determine which song is playing then and how far into that song playback has progressed.
title: Circular Playlist

label: ABC264C
cn: 给定矩阵A(H1×W1)与B(H2×W2)。判断能否从A中删除若干整行和整列，使剩余矩阵恰好等于B。
en: Given matrices A (H1 by W1) and B (H2 by W2), determine whether deleting some whole rows and columns from A can make the remaining matrix exactly B.
title: Matrix Reducing

label: ABC263C
cn: 给定N、M。按字典序输出所有长度为N的严格递增整数序列，且每项均在1⋯M。
en: Given N and M, output in lexicographic order all strictly increasing length-N integer sequences whose elements lie in 1...M.
title: Monotonically Increasing

label: ABC233C
cn: 有N个袋子，第i个袋子含若干正整数。每个袋子恰选一个数，统计所选N个数的乘积恰为X的选法数。
en: There are N bags containing positive integers. Choose exactly one number from each bag and count the choices whose product is exactly X.
title: Product

label: ABC229C
cn: 有N种奶酪，第i种每克美味度Ai、最多Bi克。最多取W克，求总美味度最大值。
en: There are N cheese types; type i has deliciousness Ai per gram and at most Bi grams available. Taking at most W grams total, maximize total deliciousness.
title: Cheese

label: ABC228C
cn: N名选手已完成三场测试，第i人前三场总分已知。还会有一场满分300的测试。判断每个人是否仍有可能进入总分前K名。
en: N contestants have scores from three tests, and one more test worth at most 300 remains. For each contestant, determine whether they can still possibly finish in the top K by total score.
title: Final Day

label: ABC218C
cn: 给定两个N×N的#/.图形S、T。允许将S旋转0/90/180/270度并平移；判断#组成的形状是否能与T完全重合。
en: Given two N by N #/. patterns S and T, you may rotate S by 0,90,180,270 degrees and translate it. Determine whether the shapes formed by # cells can coincide exactly.
title: Shapes

label: ABC212C
cn: 给定数组A、B。求|Ai-Bj|在所有i,j中的最小值。
en: Given arrays A and B, find the minimum possible value of |Ai-Bj| over all pairs i,j.
title: Min Difference

label: ABC216C
cn: 初始值为0。操作A：加1；操作B：乘2。给定正整数N，输出任意一串A/B操作，使最终值恰为N。
en: Start from 0. Operation A adds 1; operation B doubles the current value. Given positive integer N, output any sequence of A/B operations that reaches exactly N.
title: Many Balls

label: ABC213C
cn: H×W网格上有N个点(Ai,Bi)。删除所有不含任何点的行与列后，输出每个点的新行号和新列号。
en: N points (Ai,Bi) lie on an H by W grid. Delete every row and column containing no point, then output the new row and column indices of each point.
title: Reorder Cards

label: ABC208C
cn: 把K个糖分给N个人。先每人尽可能平均分，剩余糖按给定编号Ai从小到大依次每人多1个。输出每个人最终获得的糖数。
en: Distribute K candies among N people as evenly as possible; any remainder is given one each in increasing order of the given labels Ai. Output each person’s final number of candies.
title: Fair Candy Distribution

label: ABC203C
cn: 从村庄0出发，手上有K元。走1个单位路程花1元；到达朋友所在位置Ai时获得Bi元。求最多能到达的坐标。
en: Start at village 0 with K yen. Moving one unit costs 1 yen; reaching a friend at position Ai gives Bi yen. Find the farthest coordinate you can reach.
title: Friends and Travel costs

label: ABC201C
cn: 给定长度10的字符串，位置0⋯9分别标记o/x/?：o表示该数字必须至少出现一次，x表示不能出现，?不限。统计满足条件的4位十进制字符串数量。
en: A length-10 pattern labels digits 0...9 by o/x/?: o must appear at least once, x must not appear,? is unrestricted. Count valid four-digit strings, leading zeros allowed.
title: Secret Number

label: ABC200C
cn: 给定N个整数。统计满足i<j且Ai与Aj除以200余数相同的下标对数量。
en: Given N integers, count index pairs i<j for which Ai and Aj have the same remainder modulo 200.
title: Ringo's Favorite Numbers 2

label: ABC183C
cn: 有N个城市及旅行时间矩阵T。从城市1出发，恰好访问其余每个城市一次后回到1。统计总时间恰为K的访问顺序数量。
en: Given travel times between N cities, start at city 1, visit every other city exactly once, and return to 1. Count routes whose total time is exactly K.
title: Travel

label: ABC181C
cn: 给定N个二维整数点。判断是否存在三个不同的点共线。
en: Given N integer points in the plane, determine whether any three distinct points are collinear.
title: Collinearity

label: ABC175B
cn: 给定N根长度Li的木棒。统计选三根能构成非退化三角形且三边长度两两不同的选法数量。
en: Given N sticks of lengths Li, count triples that form a non-degenerate triangle and have three pairwise distinct side lengths.
title: Making Triangle

label: ABC172C
cn: 有两摞书A、B，只能从各自顶部按顺序读；读第i本耗时对应数组值。总时间不超过K，求最多能读多少本。
en: There are two stacks of books A and B; books can only be read from the top in order, with given reading times. Under total time K, maximize the number of books read.
title: Tsundoku

label: ABC157C
cn: 寻找最小的N位非负整数（N=1时可为0），满足若干约束：第s_i位数字必须等于c_i。若不存在输出-1。
en: Find the smallest N-digit nonnegative integer (0 is allowed when N=1) satisfying constraints that digit s_i must equal c_i. Print -1 if impossible.
title: Guess The Number

label: ABC141C
cn: N名选手初始各有K分。进行Q次正确回答记录，每次对应选手相对其他人增加一次优势；最终若某人的有效分数大于0输出Yes，否则No。
en: N contestants start with K points. Q correct-answer events are recorded; after accounting for the Q rounds, print Yes for each contestant whose effective score remains positive, otherwise No.
title: Attack Survival

label: ABC138C
cn: 给定N个数。每次选两个数x,y删除并加入(x+y)/2，直到剩一个数。通过选择顺序使最终值最大，并输出该最大值。
en: Given N numbers, repeatedly remove two values x,y and insert (x+y)/2 until one remains. Choose the order of operations to maximize the final value.
title: Alchemist

label: ABC137C
cn: 给定N个小写字符串。若两个字符串互为字母重排则视为一对anagram。统计这样的无序字符串对数量。
en: Given N lowercase strings, count unordered pairs that are anagrams of each other.
title: Green Bin

label: ABC136C
cn: 给定高度序列H。每个位置的高度最多可降低1次、每次降低1。判断是否能通过这些操作使序列从左到右非递减。
en: Given heights H, each height may be decreased by 1 at most once. Determine whether the sequence can be made nondecreasing from left to right.
title: Build Stairs

label: ABC135C
cn: 有N+1座城市，第i座城市有Ai个怪物；第i位勇者可依次攻击城市i和i+1，总攻击上限Bi。求最多消灭多少怪物。
en: There are N+1 cities with Ai monsters. Hero i can attack cities i and i+1 with total capacity Bi, in that order. Find the maximum number of monsters that can be defeated.
title: City Savers

label: ABC133C
cn: 给定L≤R。求L≤i<j≤R时(i×j) mod 2019的最小值。
en: Given L<=R, find the minimum value of (i*j) mod 2019 over all L<=i<j<=R.
title: Remainder Minimization 2019

label: ABC132C
cn: 给定N个难度值，N为偶数。把题目分成较易与较难两组且每组N/2个，求可作为两组分界整数难度的数量。
en: Given an even number N of difficulty values, split them into N/2 easier and N/2 harder problems. Count integer threshold values that can separate the two groups.
title: Divide the Problems

label: ABC109B
cn: 给定N个单词。要求每个单词的首字母等于前一单词的末字母，且任何单词不能重复。判断整个接龙是否合法。
en: Given N words, each word must start with the last letter of the previous word, and no word may repeat. Determine whether the whole word chain is valid.
title: Shiritori

label: ABC104B
cn: 判断字符串S是否满足：首字符为A；从第3个到倒数第2个字符之间恰有一个C；除此之外所有字母均为小写。
en: Determine whether string S satisfies: the first character is A; exactly one C appears between the 3rd and secondto-last positions; all other letters are lowercase.
title: AcCepted

label: ABC103B
cn: 给定等长字符串S、T。一次操作把S的最后一个字符移到最前面。判断若干次操作后能否得到T。
en: Given equal-length strings S and T, one operation moves the last character of S to the front. Determine whether repeated operations can transform S into T.
title: String Rotation

label: ABC076C
cn: 给定字符串S（含小写字母与?）和小写字符串T。把每个?替换为任意小写字母，使最终S包含T作为连续子串；若可行输出字典序最小结果，否则输出UNRESTORABLE。
en: Given S containing lowercase letters and?, and lowercase string T, replace each? so that the final S contains T as a contiguous substring. Output the lexicographically smallest possible result, or UNRESTORABLE if impossible.
title: Dubious Document 2

label: ABC075B
cn: 给定H×W的雷区，#表示地雷、.表示空格。对每个空格输出其周围8个相邻格中的地雷数，地雷格仍输出#。
en: Given an H by W minefield with # for mines and. for empty cells, replace each empty cell by the number of mines among its eight neighbors, leaving # unchanged.
title: Minesweeper

label: ABC073C
cn: 依次写下N个整数；若某个整数已经写在黑板上，则擦掉它，否则写上它。全部操作后，求黑板上剩余整数的数量。
en: Process N integers one by one: if a value is already on the board, erase it; otherwise write it. After all operations, output how many values remain.
title: Write and Erase

label: ABC344C
cn: 给定三个数列A、B、C以及Q个询问X_i。对每个X_i，判断是否能从A、B、C各选一个元素，使三者之和恰为X_i。
en: Given three sequences A, B, and C and Q query values X_i, determine for each X_i whether one element can be chosen from each sequence so that their sum is exactly X_i.
title: A+B+C

label: ABC343C
cn: 给定正整数N≤10^18。求不超过N的最大整数K，使K既是某个正整数的立方，又是十进制回文数。
en: Given a positive integer N<=10^18, find the largest K<=N that is both a perfect cube and a decimal palindrome.

label: ABC342C
cn: 给定长度N的小写字符串S和Q次操作。每次把当前S中所有字符c_i同时替换为d_i；输出全部操作后的字符串。
en: Given a lowercase string S of length N and Q operations, each operation replaces every current occurrence of c_i with d_i. Print the final string.
title: Many Replacement

label: ABC341C
cn: 给定H×W的#/.网格和一串N个移动指令。统计有多少个起始道路格，使从该格出发依次执行所有指令时始终不越界且不进入墙格。
en: Given an H by W grid of # and. and a string of N moves, count starting open cells from which following all moves never leaves the grid or enters a wall.
title: Takahashi Gets Lost

label: ABC340C
cn: 从整数N开始。每次把一个x≥2分成floor(x/2)与ceil(x/2)，并付出代价x；重复直到所有数均为1。求总代价。
en: Start from integer N. Each time, split a value x>=2 into floor(x/2) and ceil(x/2) and pay cost x; repeat until all values are 1. Find the total cost.
title: Divide and Divide

label: ABC339B
cn: 有一个H×W的环面网格，所有格初始为白色‘.‘。蚂蚁初始位于左上角(1,1)且面朝上。重复N次：若当前格为白色，则将其涂成黑色‘#‘并向右转90°；若为黑色，则涂成白色并向左转90°；随后沿当前朝向前进一格。越过上/下/左/右边界时从相对边出现。输出N次操作后的整个网格。
en: Consider an H by W toroidal grid whose cells are initially white ‘.‘. An ant starts at the top-left cell (1,1), facing up. Repeat N times: if the current cell is white, paint it black ‘#‘ and turn 90 degrees right; if it is black, paint it white and turn 90 degrees left; then move one cell forward. Moving past an edge wraps to the opposite edge. Output the entire grid after N operations.
title: Langton's Takahashi

label: ABC332B
cn: 有容量G的玻璃杯和容量M的马克杯，初始均为空。重复K次以下操作：若玻璃杯已满，则把玻璃杯倒空；否则若马克杯为空，则把马克杯装满；否则从马克杯向玻璃杯倒水，直到马克杯变空或玻璃杯装满。输出K次操作后玻璃杯和马克杯中的水量。
en: There is a glass of capacity G and a mug of capacity M, both initially empty. Repeat K times: if the glass is full, empty it; otherwise, if the mug is empty, fill it; otherwise pour from the mug into the glass until the mug becomes empty or the glass becomes full. Output the amounts of water in the glass and mug after K operations.
title: Glass and Mug

label: ABC364B
cn: 给定带墙#的H×W网格、起点和一串U/D/L/R指令。依次尝试移动；若目标越界或为墙则原地不动。输出最终坐标。
en: Given an H by W grid with walls #, a start cell, and a U/D/L/R command string, attempt each move in order; if the destination is outside the grid or a wall, stay put. Output the final coordinates.
title: Grid Walk

label: ABC376B
cn: N个位置围成环，左手初始在1、右手在2。每次命令要求指定一只手移动到目标位置，移动时不能经过另一只手。求完成全部命令所需的最少单步移动次数总和。
en: N positions form a ring; the left hand starts at 1 and the right at 2. Each command moves one specified hand to a target position without passing through the other hand. Find the minimum total number of single-step moves.
title: Hands on Ring (Easy)

label: ABC325C
cn: 给定H×W的#/.网格。若两个#格在8邻域内相邻，则属于同一传感器连通块。求连通块数量。
en: Given an H by W #/. grid, # cells connected through any of the eight neighboring directions belong to the same sensor component. Count the components.
title: Sensors

label: ABC304C
cn: 平面上有N个人，第1人最初感染。若一个已感染者与另一个人的欧氏距离不超过D，则后者也会感染。传播充分久后，输出每个人是否感染。
en: N people are points in the plane; person 1 is initially infected. An infected person infects anyone within Euclidean distance D. After propagation stabilizes, output whether each person is infected.
title: Virus

label: ABC312C
cn: N个卖家各有最低售价Ai，M个买家各有最高买价Bj。求最小整数价格x，使愿意以不高于x出售的卖家数不少于愿意以不低于x购买的买家数。
en: N sellers have minimum acceptable prices Ai and M buyers have maximum acceptable prices Bj. Find the smallest integer price x such that the number of sellers willing to sell at x is at least the number of buyers willing to buy at x.
title: Invisible Hand

label: ABC309C
cn: 第i种药从第1天起连续ai天、每天服bi片。求从第1天开始，第一次当日总服药片数不超过K的日期。
en: Medicine type i is taken for ai consecutive days from day 1, bi pills per day. Find the first day on which the total number of pills required that day is at most K.
title: Medicine

label: ABC302D
cn: 给定数组A、B与D。选择一个Ai和一个Bj，要求|Ai-Bj|≤D；在满足条件的选择中最大化Ai+Bj。若不存在可行对输出-1。
en: Given arrays A and B and integer D, choose Ai and Bj with |Ai-Bj|<=D and maximize Ai+Bj. Print -1 if no feasible pair exists.
title: Impartial Gift

label: ABC300D
cn: 给定N≤10^12。统计可表示为a^2*b*c^2的正整数数量，其中a<b<c且a,b,c均为素数，结果不超过N。
en: Given N<=10^12, count positive integers at most N representable as a^2*b*c^2 for primes a<b<c.
title: AABCC

label: ABC287D
cn: 给定含小写字母和?的字符串S、T，且|S|>|T|。对x=0⋯|T|，取S的前x个字符和后|T|-x个字符拼接为S’；?可替换为任意字母。判断S’是否能与T匹配。
en: Given strings S and T containing lowercase letters and?, with |S|>|T|. For each x=0...|T|, form S’ from the first x and last |T|-x characters of S;? may match any letter. Determine whether S’ can match T.
title: Match or Not

label: ABC286D
cn: 有N种硬币，第i种面值ai、最多bi枚。判断能否恰好凑出总金额X。
en: There are N coin types; type i has value ai and at most bi copies. Determine whether an exact total of X can be formed.
title: Money in Hand

label: ABC282D
cn: 给定简单无向图G。统计当前没有边连接的顶点对(u,v)，使给G加上边(u,v)后仍然是二部图。
en: Given a simple undirected graph G, count non-edge vertex pairs (u,v) such that adding edge (u,v) keeps the graph bipartite.
title: Make Bipartite 2

label: ABC281D
cn: 给定非负数组A。恰选K个不同下标，使所选元素和为D的倍数；求可能的最大和，若不存在输出-1。
en: Given a nonnegative array A, choose exactly K distinct elements whose sum is divisible by D. Find the maximum possible sum, or -1 if impossible.
title: Max Multiple

label: ABC233D
cn: 给定长度N的整数数组A和整数K。统计和恰为K的连续子数组数量。
en: Given an integer array A of length N and integer K, count contiguous subarrays whose sum is exactly K.
title: Count Interval

label: ABC229D
cn: 给定只含X和.的字符串S。最多把K个.改成X，求最终能够得到的最长连续X段长度。
en: Given a string S of X and., change at most K dots into X and find the maximum possible length of a consecutive X segment.
title: Longest X

label: ABC228D
cn: 长度2^20的数组初始全为-1。查询1 x：从h=x开始循环向右寻找第一个A[h mod N]=-1的位置并写入x；查询2 x：输出A[x mod N]。处理全部查询。
en: An array of length 2^20 starts all -1. Query 1 x: starting from h=x, move right cyclically to the first empty A[h mod N] and store x; query 2 x: output A[x mod N]. Process all queries.
title: Linear Probing

label: ABC219D
cn: 有N个便当，第i个含Ai个章鱼烧和Bi个鲷鱼烧，每个最多买一次。至少获得X个章鱼烧和Y个鲷鱼烧，求购买便当数的最小值；无解输出-1。
en: There are N lunchboxes; box i contains Ai takoyaki and Bi taiyaki and may be bought at most once. Reach at least X and Y respectively using the minimum number of boxes; print -1 if impossible.
title: Strange Lunchbox

label: ABC218D
cn: 给定平面上N个整数点。统计边与坐标轴平行、且四个顶点都在给定点集中的矩形数量。
en: Given N integer points in the plane, count axis-aligned rectangles whose four vertices all belong to the given point set.
title: Rectangles

label: ABC216D
cn: 有M个筒，N种颜色的球，每种颜色恰出现两次；只能取各筒最上面的球。若两个筒顶部颜色相同，可同时取走这两个球。判断能否最终取走全部球。
en: There are M stacks of balls and N colors, each color appearing exactly twice. Only top balls are accessible; when two stack tops share a color, both may be removed. Determine whether all balls can be removed.
title: Pair of Balls

label: ABC209D
cn: 给定一棵N个城镇、N-1条双向道路组成的树，以及Q个查询。每个查询给出城镇c、d，两人同时分别从c、d出发，以相同速度沿唯一最短路径相向而行。若二人在某个城镇相遇，输出Town；若在某条道路内部相遇，输出Road。需依次回答全部Q个查询。
en: Given a tree of N towns and N-1 bidirectional roads and Q queries, each query gives towns c and d. Two people leave c and d simultaneously and move toward each other along the unique path at the same speed. Print Town if they meet at a town, and Road if they meet in the interior of a road. Answer all Q queries.
title: Collision

label: ABC203D
cn: 给定N×N高度矩阵A和整数K（1≤K≤N≤800）。对任意完全位于矩阵内的K×K子正方形，把其中K²个高度按从高到低排列，并把第floor(K²/2)+1高的值定义为该子正方形的“中位数”。求所有K×K子正方形中该中位数的最小可能值。每个Aij满足0≤Aij≤10^9。
en: Given an N by N height matrix A and an integer K (1<=K<=N<=800), consider every K by K sub-square fully contained in the matrix. Sort its K^2 heights from high to low and define its median as the (floor(K^2/2)+1)-th highest value. Find the minimum possible median over all such sub-squares. Every Aij satisfies 0<=Aij<=10^9.
title: Pond

label: ABC185D
cn: 长度N的条带上有M个已涂蓝的位置，其余为白。选择一个固定宽度k的印章，每次可把连续k个白格涂蓝且不能覆盖蓝格。选择k并最小化涂完所有白格的盖章次数。
en: On a strip of length N, M positions are already blue. Choose one fixed stamp width k; each use paints k consecutive white cells and cannot cover blue cells. Choose k to minimize the number of stamps needed to paint all white cells.
title: Stamp

label: ABC183D
cn: 第i个用户在时间区间[Si,Ti)内持续用水Pi。供水系统每时刻最多供W。判断任意时刻总用水量是否都不超过W。
en: User i consumes Pi units of water throughout interval [Si,Ti). The system capacity is W at every moment. Determine whether total usage never exceeds W.
title: Water Heater

label: ABC177D
cn: N个人之间给出M条朋友关系，朋友关系可传递形成群体。求最大朋友连通分量的人数。
en: N people have M friendship edges; friendship connectivity forms groups. Find the size of the largest connected component.
title: Friends

label: ABC157D
cn: N人有M条朋友关系和K条拉黑关系。对每个人，统计与其同一朋友连通分量内、既不是直接朋友也未被其拉黑、且不是本人的人数。
en: Among N people with friendship and block relations, for each person count others in the same friendship component who are neither direct friends nor blocked by that person, excluding self.
title: Friend Suggestions

label: ABC141D
cn: N件商品价格Ai，有M张优惠券。每张券可选一件商品把当前价格变为floor(price/2)。使用全部M张券后，求总价最小值。
en: N items have prices Ai and there are M coupons. Each coupon replaces one chosen current price with floor(price/2). After using all M coupons, find the minimum possible total price.
title: Powerful Discount Tickets

label: ABC138D
cn: 给定以1为根的树和Q次操作(p,x)：把x加到顶点p及其所有后代。完成全部操作后，输出每个顶点的值。
en: Given a tree rooted at 1 and Q operations (p,x), add x to vertex p and every descendant of p. After all operations, output every vertex value.
title: Ki

label: ABC109D
cn: 给定H×W非负整数网格。一次操作可把某格的1个单位移动到其上下左右相邻格。构造不超过限制的操作序列，使最终至多一个格子的值为奇数。
en: Given an H by W grid of nonnegative integers, one operation moves one unit to an orthogonally adjacent cell. Construct a valid sequence of operations so that at most one cell has an odd value at the end.
title: Make Them Even

label: ABC075C
cn: 给定N点M边的连通无向图。若删除一条边后图不再连通，则该边为桥。求桥的数量。
en: Given a connected undirected graph with N vertices and M edges, an edge is a bridge if deleting it disconnects the graph. Count the bridges.
title: Bridge

label: ABC344D
cn: 给定目标字符串T和N个按顺序处理的字符串袋。初始字符串S为空。处理第i个袋时，可以什么也不做，也可以支付1的代价，从该袋中恰选一个字符串接到S的末尾；每个袋最多使用一次且必须按1,...,N的顺序处理。求最终使S=T的最小总代价；若无法做到，输出-1。T长度为1～100，每个袋含1～10个长度为1～10的小写字符串。
en: Given a target string T and N bags of strings processed in order, start with S empty. When processing bag i, either do nothing or pay cost 1 to choose exactly one string from that bag and append it to S; each bag can be used at most once and bags are processed from 1 through N. Find the minimum total cost to end with S=T, or print -1 if impossible. |T| is 1 to 100; each bag contains 1 to 10 lowercase strings of length 1 to 10.
title: String Bags

label: ABC343D
cn: N名选手初始得分均为0。进行T次更新，每次给选手A_i增加B_i分；每次更新后输出当前不同得分值的种类数。
en: N players start at score 0. For T updates, add B_i points to player A_i; after each update, output the number of distinct score values currently present.
title: Diversity of Scores

label: ABC342D
cn: 给定N个非负整数A_i。统计下标对i<j，使乘积A_i×A_j是完全平方数。
en: Given N nonnegative integers A_i, count index pairs i<j for which A_i*A_j is a perfect square.
title: Square Pair

label: ABC341D
cn: 给定正整数N、M、K。把所有“能被N或M中恰好一个整除”的正整数按升序排列，求第K个。
en: Given positive integers N, M, and K, list positive integers divisible by exactly one of N and M in increasing order and find the K-th one.
title: Only one of two

label: ABC340D
cn: 有N个节点。对每个i<N，可花A_i从i到i+1，或花B_i从i跳到X_i。求从1到N的最小总代价。
en: There are N nodes. From each i<N, you may pay A_i to go to i+1 or B_i to jump to X_i. Find the minimum total cost from 1 to N.
title: Super Takahashi Bros.

label: ABC339C
cn: 给定整数变化量A_1..A_N。选择最小的非负初始值X，使依次加上这些变化量后的所有前缀值都不为负；输出执行完全部变化后的最终值。
en: Given integer changes A_1..A_N, choose the smallest nonnegative initial value X such that every running total remains nonnegative, and output the final value after all changes.
title: Perfect Bus

label: ABC338C
cn: 有N种原料，库存Q_i；菜A、B每份分别消耗A_i、B_i。只能制作整数份，求两种菜合计最多能做多少份。
en: There are N ingredients with stocks Q_i. One serving of dishes A and B consumes A_i and B_i of each ingredient. Make integer numbers of servings and maximize the total number of servings.
title: Leftover Recipes

label: ABC337C
cn: N个人排成一列。A_i=-1表示i在队首，否则i紧跟在A_i后面；保证排列唯一。输出从前到后的人员编号。
en: N people stand in a line. A_i=-1 means person i is first; otherwise i stands immediately behind A_i. The arrangement is unique. Output the line from front to back.
title: Lining Up 2

label: ABC336C
cn: 若一个非负整数的十进制表示只含0、2、4、6、8，则称为好整数。给定N≤10^12，求从小到大第N个好整数。
en: A nonnegative integer is good if its decimal representation uses only digits 0,2,4,6,8. Given N<=10^12, find the N-th smallest good integer.
title: Even Digits

label: ABC335C
cn: 一条N节龙初始第i节在(i,0)。处理Q个查询：移动龙头一格并让后续各节跟随前一节的旧位置，或询问第p节当前坐标。
en: A dragon of N parts initially has part i at (i,0). Process Q queries that either move the head one step with every later part following the previous position of its predecessor, or ask for the current coordinates of part p.
title: Loong Tracking

label: ABC176D
cn: 给定H×W迷宫，‘.‘为可通行格、‘#‘为墙，并给出起点(Ch,Cw)与终点(Dh,Dw)。可以免费走到上下左右相邻的可通行格；也可以消耗1次魔法，跳到以当前位置为中心、行列差均不超过2的5×5范围内任意可通行格。求到达终点所需的最少魔法次数；若无法到达，输出-1。
en: Given an H by W maze with open cells ‘.‘ and walls ‘#‘, a start (Ch,Cw), and a goal (Dh,Dw), you may move for free to an orthogonally adjacent open cell, or spend one warp to move to any open cell whose row and column differ from the current cell by at most 2 (the surrounding 5 by 5 square). Find the minimum number of warps needed to reach the goal, or -1 if impossible.
title: Wizard in Maze

label: ABC311C
cn: 有N个顶点，每个顶点i恰有一条有向边i→Ai，且Ai≠i。保证从任意顶点不断沿出边前进最终会进入一个有向环。找出任意一个顶点不重复的有向环：先输出环的顶点数K，再按沿边前进的顺序输出这K个顶点。
en: There are N vertices, and each vertex i has exactly one outgoing edge i->Ai with Ai!=i. Repeatedly following outgoing edges must eventually enter a directed cycle. Find any directed cycle with no repeated vertex: first print its size K, then print the K vertices in edge-following order.
title: Find it!

label: ABC317C
cn: 给定N≤10个城市和带正长度的无向道路。从任意城市出发，不重复访问城市，求可经过道路总长度的最大值。
en: Given N<=10 cities and positive-length undirected roads, start anywhere and never revisit a city. Find the maximum total length of roads that can be traversed.
title: Remembering the Days

label: ABC304D
cn: 矩形蛋糕上有N个草莓。用若干条竖直切线x=ai和水平切线y=bj把蛋糕切成小块。求所有小块中草莓数的最小值和最大值，空块也计入最小值。
en: A rectangular cake has N strawberries and is cut by vertical lines x=ai and horizontal lines y=bj. Find the minimum and maximum number of strawberries among all pieces, counting empty pieces.
title: A Piece of Cake

label: ABC293D
cn: 有N根绳子，每根两端分别为红、蓝。给定M次把指定绳端两两连接的操作。最终对每个连通绳组判断是否成环，输出成环组数与非成环组数。
en: There are N ropes, each with a red and blue end. M operations connect specified rope ends. For the final connected rope groups, output how many form cycles and how many do not.
title: Tying Rope

label: ABC291D
cn: N张卡片排成一列，第i张正反面分别写Ai、Bi。可独立决定每张是否翻面。统计翻面方案，使任意相邻两张朝上的数字都不同；答案模998244353。
en: N cards lie in a row; card i shows Ai on one side and Bi on the other. Choose independently whether to flip each card. Count configurations where every adjacent pair shows different numbers, modulo 998244353.
title: Flip Cards

label: ABC276D
cn: 给定正整数数组A。一次可选一个能被2或3整除的元素并分别除以2或3。求把所有元素变成相等所需的最少操作数；若不可能输出-1。
en: Given a positive integer array A, one operation divides one element by 2 or 3 when divisible. Find the minimum operations to make all elements equal, or -1 if impossible.
title: Divide by 2 or 3

label: ABC275C
cn: 给定9×9的#/.网格，把每个#看作平面上的点。统计四个顶点均为#的正方形数量，正方形边不要求平行于坐标轴。
en: Given a 9 by 9 #/. grid, regard # cells as points. Count squares whose four vertices are # cells; the square need not be axis-aligned.
title: Counting Squares

label: ABC272D
cn: N×N网格起点为(1,1)。一步可移动到与当前格欧氏距离恰为√M的任意格。对所有格输出从起点到达的最少步数，不可达输出-1。
en: On an N by N grid starting from (1,1), one move may go to any cell at Euclidean distance exactly sqrt(M). For every cell, output the minimum number of moves from the start, or -1 if unreachable.
title: Root M Leaper

label: ABC270C
cn: 给定一棵N点树及两个不同顶点X、Y。按从X到Y的顺序输出二者之间唯一简单路径上的全部顶点。
en: Given a tree with N vertices and distinct vertices X and Y, output all vertices on the unique simple path from X to Y in order.
title: Simple path

label: ABC266D
cn: 数轴上只有位置0⋯4。人物从时间0、位置0出发，每单位时间最多移动1。若在时刻Ti位于Xi，可获得价值Ai。求可获得价值总和的最大值。
en: Only positions 0...4 exist on a line. Starting at position 0 at time 0, you may move at speed at most 1. If you are at Xi at time Ti, you may collect value Ai. Maximize the total value collected.
title: Snuke Panic (1D)

label: ABC264D
cn: 给定字符串S，它是atcoder的一个排列。一次操作可交换相邻两个字符。求把S变为atcoder的最少交换次数。
en: Given a string S that is a permutation of atcoder, one operation swaps two adjacent characters. Find the minimum number of swaps needed to transform S into atcoder.
title: "redocta".swap(i,i+1)

label: ABC254D
cn: 给定N≤2×10^5。统计有序正整数对(i,j)，其中1≤i,j≤N且i×j为完全平方数。
en: Given N<=2*10^5, count ordered positive integer pairs (i,j) with 1<=i,j<=N such that i*j is a perfect square.
title: Together Square

label: ABC248D
cn: 给定长度N的数组A和Q个查询(L,R,X)。每个查询要求统计区间A[L⋯R]中值等于X的元素个数。
en: Given an array A of length N and Q queries (L,R,X), answer how many elements equal X in the subarray A[L...R] for each query.
title: Range Count Query

label: ABC246D
cn: 给定0≤N≤10^18。函数f(a,b)=a^3+a^2b+ab^2+b^3，其中a,b为非负整数。求满足f(a,b)≥N的最小函数值。
en: Given 0<=N<=10^18 and f(a,b)=a^3+a^2*b+a*b^2+b^3 for nonnegative integers a,b, find the minimum value of f(a,b) that is at least N.
title: 2-variable Function

label: ABC344E
cn: 维护一个初始元素互异的整数序列，处理两类查询：在值x的元素后插入y，或删除值x的元素。所有查询后输出最终序列。
en: Maintain a sequence of distinct integers under two query types: insert y immediately after the element with value x, or delete the element with value x. Print the final sequence.
title: Insert or Erase

label: ABC342E
cn: 有N个车站和M条列车信息。第i条信息为(li,di,ki,ci,Ai,Bi)：对j=0,...,ki-1，存在一班列车在时刻li+j·di从Ai出发，并在ci时间后到达Bi；除此之外没有别的列车，也不能用其他方式在不同车站间移动，换乘耗时视为0。对每个车站S=1,...,N-1，求最晚可在何时从S开始行程仍能最终到达车站N；若永远无法到达，则输出Unreachable。N、M≤2×10^5，li、di、ki、ci≤10^9。
en: There are N stations and M train schedules. Schedule i is (li,di,ki,ci,Ai,Bi): for each j=0,...,ki-1, a train leaves Ai at time li+j*di and reaches Bi ci time units later. No other trains or inter-station travel exist, and transfers take zero time. For every station S=1,...,N-1, find the latest time at which one can start from S and still eventually reach station N; print Unreachable if it is impossible. N,M<=2*10^5 and li,di,ki,ci<=10^9.
title: Last Train

label: ABC341E
cn: 给定二进制字符串S，处理两类区间查询：把区间[L,R]内所有位翻转，或判断该区间相邻字符是否全部不同。对判断查询输出Yes/No。
en: Given a binary string S, process range queries that either flip every bit in [L,R] or ask whether every adjacent pair inside that range is different. Output Yes/No for the latter queries.
title: Alternating String

label: ABC340E
cn: N个盒子围成环，第i个盒子初始有A_i个球。依次处理位置B_i：取出该盒的全部x个球，然后从下一个盒子开始沿环每经过一个盒子放入1个球，共放x次。输出最终各盒球数。
en: N boxes are arranged in a cycle with initial counts A_i. For each position B_i, remove all x balls from that box, then starting from the next box place one ball at each visited box cyclically, for exactly x placements. Output the final counts.
title: Mancala 2

label: ABC339D
cn: N×N网格上有两名玩家。每次给出同一个方向，两人都尝试移动；若撞墙或越界则该人留在原地。求使两人首次位于同一格所需的最少操作次数，不可能则输出-1。
en: Two players are on an N by N grid. Each operation chooses one common direction; each player moves if possible, otherwise stays. Find the minimum number of operations until they occupy the same cell, or -1 if impossible.
title: Synchronized Players

label: ABC338D
cn: N个岛按环形排列，桥i（1≤i<N）连接岛i与i+1，桥N连接岛N与1，且岛间只能经桥移动。一次旅行从X1出发，并必须按顺序访问X2,...,XM；途中可经过其他岛，旅行长度为跨桥次数。现在必须封闭恰好一座桥。可以同时最优选择所封闭的桥以及每段行程的路线，求旅行长度的最小可能值。约束：3≤N≤2×10^5，2≤M≤2×10^5，且相邻的Xi不相同。
en: N islands form a cycle: bridge i (1<=i<N) connects i and i+1, and bridge N connects N and 1; bridges are the only way to travel. A tour starts at X1 and must visit X2,...,XM in order, possibly passing through other islands, and its length is the number of bridge crossings. Exactly one bridge must be closed. Choose the closed bridge and all routes optimally and find the minimum possible tour length. Constraints: 3<=N<=2*10^5, 2<=M<=2*10^5, and consecutive Xi are different.
title: Island Tour

label: ABC337D
cn: H×W网格含o、x、.。可以把任意.改为o。求形成一段横向或纵向连续K个o所需的最少修改次数；若不可能输出-1。
en: An H by W grid contains the characters 'o', 'x', and '.'. You may change any '.' to 'o'. Find the minimum number of changes needed to create K consecutive 'o' cells horizontally or vertically, or -1 if impossible.
title: Cheating Gomoku Narabe

label: ABC336D
cn: 对正整数k，定义“大小为k的金字塔数列”为1,2,...,k-1,k,k-1,...,2,1。给定长度N的正整数数列A。可以重复执行两类操作：任选一个元素并将其减1；或删除数列的首元素或末元素。求通过若干次操作能够得到的金字塔数列的最大大小k。约束：1≤N≤2×10^5，1≤Ai≤10^9。
en: For a positive integer k, define a pyramid sequence of size k as 1,2,...,k-1,k,k-1,...,2,1. Given a positive-integer sequence A of length N, you may repeatedly either choose one element and decrease it by 1, or delete the first or last element. Find the maximum size k of a pyramid sequence obtainable after any number of operations. Constraints: 1<=N<=2*10^5 and 1<=Ai<=10^9.
title: Pyramid

label: ABC333D
cn: 给定一棵N个顶点的树。一次操作可以删除一个叶子顶点及其相连的边。求为了删除顶点1，至少需要进行多少次操作。
en: Given a tree with N vertices. In one operation, remove a leaf vertex and its incident edge. Find the minimum number of operations required to remove vertex 1.
title: Erase Leaves

label: ABC332D
cn: 给定两个H×W矩阵A、B。一次操作可交换相邻两行或相邻两列。求把A变成B的最少操作次数；若不可能输出-1。
en: Given two H by W matrices A and B, one operation swaps two adjacent rows or two adjacent columns. Find the minimum operations to transform A into B, or -1 if impossible.
title: Swapping Puzzle
